en.headline: Man found hanged in Sham Shui Po estate room dies at hospital
en.dek: Police said a 33-year-old man was discovered by family at Fu Cheong Estate around 6:10am and was pronounced dead after being taken to Caritas Medical Centre.
body: Police said a 33-year-old man surnamed Wong was found hanged in a room at Fu Ying House in Fu Cheong Estate, Sham Shui Po, at about 6:10am on Sunday.
Family members discovered him, cut him down and called for help. Ambulance crews took him to Caritas Medical Centre, where he was later confirmed dead. No suicide note was found at the scene.
Preliminary inquiries suggested the man may have been troubled by financial difficulties. The cause of death will be determined after an autopsy.
If you or someone you know is in distress, support is available through the Hospital Authority mental health hotline on 2466 7350 or the Samaritan Befrienders on 2389 2222.

zh.headline: 深水埗富昌邨33歲男子被發現上吊 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方指今早約6時10分，家人在富盈樓發現事主，解下後報案，送明愛醫院後證實死亡，現場沒有遺書。
body: 警方表示，今早約6時10分，深水埗富昌邨富盈樓一名33歲姓黃男子在單位房間內被家人發現上吊。
家人即時將他解下並報警求助。救護人員將他送往明愛醫院搶救，其後證實死亡。警方在現場沒有檢獲遺書。
初步調查相信事主或因財務問題受困擾。死因有待驗屍後確定。
如你或身邊人感到困擾，可致電醫管局精神健康專線2466 7350或香港撒瑪利亞防止自殺會熱線2389 2222求助。
